questions.stem: Which container can hold exactly 500 ml of liquid?
questions.solution: The question asks which container can hold exactly 500 ml of liquid. The correct option is the bottle of 500 ml because its capacity matches the required volume. The other options have smaller capacities and cannot hold 500 ml.

questions.stem: How many 250 g daal packets will balance one 500 g daal packet?
questions.solution: To balance a 500 g daal packet, you need to add up 250 g packets until they total 500 g. Since 250 g + 250 g = 500 g, two packets are needed. One packet would only be 250 g, which is not enough. Three or four packets would exceed 500 g, making them incorrect.

hi.solution: 500 ग्राम दाल के पैकेट को संतुलित करने के लिए आपको 250 ग्राम के पैकेट जोड़ने होंगे जब तक कि वे कुल 500 ग्राम न हो जाएं। चूंकि 250 ग्राम + 250 ग्राम = 500 ग्राम, इसलिए दो पैकेट आवश्यक हैं। एक पैकेट केवल 250 ग्राम होगा, जो पर्याप्त नहीं होगा। तीन या चार पैकेट 500 ग्राम से अधिक हो जाएंगे, जिससे वे गलत हो जाएंगे।

questions.stem: If a container is estimated to hold 500 ml of water and it is actually measured to hold 480 ml, what is the difference in capacity?
questions.solution: The difference between 500 ml and 480 ml is 20 ml. The other options are incorrect calculations or guesses.

questions.stem: If a container can hold 250 ml and you fill it 4 times, how much total water is used?
questions.solution: Filling a 250 ml container 4 times means 250 * 4 = 1000 ml. The other options do not match this calculation.

hi.solution: 250 मिली के बर्तन को 4 बार भरना मतलब 250 * 4 = 1000 मिली है। अन्य विकल्प इस गणना के अनुरूप नहीं हैं।

questions.stem: If 10 packets of 100 grams of sugar are required to make 1 kg, how many packets of 50 grams would be needed to make 1 kg?
questions.solution: Since 10 packets of 100 grams make 1 kg, each packet is 100 grams. To make 1 kg with 50-gram packets, you need double the number, so 20 packets. The option '10' would be chosen by someone who assumes the packet size is the same, '25' by someone who adds an extra, and '50' by someone who is way off.

questions.stem: A pump can fill a tank with water in 2 hours. Because of leakage, it took 3 hours to fill the tank. How much time will it take for the leakage to drain all the water in the full tank?
questions.solution: The question is similar to a ratio problem. If the pump fills in 2 hours and with leakage takes 3 hours, the leakage rate is such that it would take 6 hours to drain the tank. Other options are incorrect because they do not match the calculation.

hi.solution: प्रश्न अनुपात समस्या के समान है। यदि पंप 2 घंटे में भरता है और लीकेज के साथ 3 घंटे में भरता है, तो लीकेज की दर ऐसी होगी कि टैंक के सारे पानी को खाली करने में 6 घंटे लगेंगे। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे गणना के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।

questions.stem: Rita bought 250 g of sugar and 100 g of salt. What is the total weight of the items she bought?
questions.solution: Rita bought 250 g of sugar and 100 g of salt, so the total is 250 + 100 = 350 grams. The option '300 g' would be chosen by someone who subtracts instead of adds, '400 g' by someone who adds incorrectly, and '450 g' by someone who miscalculates the sum.

questions.stem: A 1 litre water bottle can be filled using 500 ml bottles. How many 500 ml bottles are needed to fill a 1 litre bottle?
questions.solution: Since 1 litre is equivalent to 1000 ml, and each bottle holds 500 ml, two bottles are needed to reach 1000 ml. Choosing 1 would be incorrect because 500 ml is half a litre, not a full litre. Choosing 3 or 4 would be incorrect because they exceed the required amount.

questions.stem: A 100 g soap bar will weigh the same as 10 erasers. How many erasers will weigh the same as 250 g sugar?
questions.solution: If 10 erasers weigh 100 g, then 1 eraser weighs 10 g. Therefore, 250 g of sugar would weigh the same as 25 erasers. Other options are incorrect because they do not match this calculation.
